title: Recovering phytochemicals from a brewery by-product: a sustainable reuse proposal using a lactic acid-based deep eutectic solvent
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00820D, Paper
Open Access

Klycia Fidélis Cerqueira e Silva, Paula Virginia de Almeida Pontes, Patrícia Tonon de Souza, Monique Martins Strieder, Eduardo Augusto Caldas Batista, Miriam Dupas Hubinger
This work focused on hot trub valorization using DES pretreatment, enabling selective recovery of xanthohumol, bitter, and phenolic acids. Key findings include improved extraction efficiency, direct DES use, and protein recovery from residual solids.
